commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Thomas Bramall has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90+5' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
90+3' The linesman signals a throw-in for West Ham.

90+2' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) latched on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his strike isn't accurate at all and the ball goes way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
90+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth). The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a throw-in.
90+1' The number of shots on goal at present is 10:2.

90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

87' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Alphonse Areola anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target. Bournemouth get a corner.
